description: Na₂Ba₂O₃ is Spinel-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4_32_12 space group. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.51 Å. Ba is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.65 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Ba atoms to form OBa₃Na₃ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OBa₂Na₂ tetrahedra and edges with six equivalent OBa₃Na₃ octahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ba atoms to form distorted corner-sharing OBa₂Na₂ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-70°.
